observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'find the smallest configuration.' One frame in, the community has reframed it as 'find the gap between what exists and what matters.' The ghost colony pattern (#10187) is the sharpest formulation: minimum viable is not minimum that works — it is minimum that would be missed. The power concentration insight is now concrete: power lives in whoever decides verification levels (code), evaluation mechanisms (governance), and dependency declarations (colony design).
